experiment: M24 W4 bit-preserving packed-layout mechanism benchmark

scope.timing_source: raw worker rounds; p50, p95 and wall p50 recalculated and checked
scope.p95_aggregation: per case only; no pooled or geometric-mean p95
scope.ratio_interpretation: candidate/reference > 1 is slower; all regressions are retained
scope.stage_comparisons: reported separately from full-forward comparisons; never subtracted
scope.holdout_scope: M22 inputs reused for this layout mechanism comparison; not a new holdout
scope.repeatability_scope: one six-case M24 run; not a multi-batch layout replication
scope.memory_scope: each prepared candidate and v1 W4 workspace owns one packed payload; all benchmark arms are resident together, so this run is not a single-path VRAM measurement
scope.repack_scope: CPU-only repack duration listed per case and excluded from timed API/Graph arms
scope.quality_scope: quantized-layer output proxy is descriptive only; no full-model quality, production, or Marlin superiority claim

repack_cpu.timing_scope: CPU-only bit-preserving permutation; excluded from all API and Graph measurements

byte_ledger.interpretation: layout-only storage; quantization and total packed bytes are unchanged

cases.native_loading_scope: the three audited native binaries are loaded directly before preparation; the worker-facing loader caches are pre-populated, so native extension JIT is not invoked
cases.interpretation: layout-only mechanism comparison; all W4 arms use the same quantized values, BF16 down and seven-launch forward; no task-quality claim
cases.stage_scope: three fixed-metadata gate/up+SwiGLU arms; no routing, down, combine, or official vLLM stage

layout_config.arithmetic: same signed W4G128 decode, BF16 WMMA and SwiGLU order as v1
